'''Remen''' is a village in [[Altara]], located in the northeast of the country on the [[Lugard Road]] where it crosses the [[River Manetherendrelle]].

==Locations and notable residents==
An inn called [[Wayland's Forge]] is located in Remen, owned by [[Gainor Furlan]]. A healer named Mother [[Leich]] also lives in Remen.

==Activities==
When [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Loial]] are crossing the continent from [[Falme]] to [[Tear]], they pass through Remen. Perrin smells a stench that he later associates with [[Gray Man|Gray Men]].{{ref/book|3|33}} Later, the group flees Remen because Perrin frees [[Gaul]] and killed some [[Children of the Light|Whitecloaks]]. [[Faile Bashere]] joins the group at Remen.{{ref/book|3|35}}
